heading: Protection of services and recreational opportunities

tree.heading: Effect of subchapter
tree.text: Nothing in this subchapter limits commercial services for existing or historic recreation uses, as authorized by the permit process of the Bureau of Land Management.

tree.heading: Guided recreational opportunities
tree.text: Commercial permits to exercise guided recreational opportunities for the public that are authorized as of March 12, 2019, may continue to be authorized.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 103–433, title XIV, § 1406, as added Pub. L. 116–9, title I, § 1441, Mar. 12, 2019, 133 Stat. 710.)
